options.text: Paling mau animasi soal sulit dijelaskan? Komen.
options.assessment: It retains strongest desire, animation, a hard-to-explain problem and a comment request in separate words. But Paling mau animasi soal ... is an unnatural compressed construction without a clear subject/choice frame; with no apa/mana, it reads as a yes/no request rather than asking which problem the viewer most wants animated. Komen is colloquial relative to the established standard Komentar. Being 48 rather than 46 is not the reason for rejection.

options.text: Sulit dijelaskan? Paling mau animasi apa? Komen.
options.assessment: This 48-codepoint conversation option supplies apa and is clearer than the root sentence. However, the hard-to-explain qualifier is a detached fragment whose connection to the desired problem is only contextual; the question asks what animation without explicitly identifying the problem. It also uses colloquial Komen. It is a conditional/context-dependent alternative, not a full standard-register source approval.

options.text: Sulit dijelaskan? Paling mau animasi apa? Komentar.
options.assessment: Using Komentar restores the established register. It remains a clipped context-dependent sequence, and at 51 it is not shorter than the canonical 49; native shortenDub would reject it on that condition even though 46 itself is not a hard acceptance limit.

options.text: Dari soal yang sulit dijelaskan, mana yang paling ingin kamu animasikan? Komentar.
options.assessment: Natural standard Indonesian. The opening filters specifically for problems difficult to explain; mana asks which one; paling ingin kamu retains the strongest viewer preference; animasikan retains making it an animation; Komentar requests the reply. This deliberately clear wording is 82, above the estimated target and above the current 49; it cannot be submitted as an accepted native shortening replacement. It is a fidelity reference option, not a fit or retry approval.
